store.summary: ST25R3916 NFC scanner, hex/NDEF inspector, card emulator & .nfc library
store.description: NFC Studio unlocks the ST25R3916 13.56 MHz transceiver on the CardputerZero Cap CC1101 & NFC. Scan ISO14443-A tags (NTAG21x, MIFARE Classic), inspect color-coded page hex dumps and decoded NDEF URI/Text records, emulate 4-byte or 7-byte UIDs using hardware Passive Target mode, and manage Flipper-compatible .nfc files.
